source: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Chapter 7 (masonry structures), strength design of unreinforced and reinforced masonry walls as the MSJC (TMS 402 / ACI 530-08 Chapter 3) gives it; SI values converted from the psi of the standard (1 psi = 0.006895 MPa, c √f'm psi = 0.083 c √f'm MPa). Section and page numbers of the BNBC text are to be checked.

sources.phi: TMS 402 / ACI 530-08 Sec 3.1.4: combinations of flexure and axial load 0.90 reinforced, 0.60 unreinforced; shear 0.80; bearing 0.60
sources.modulusRatio: TMS 402 / ACI 530-08 Sec 1.8.2.2.1: Em = 700 f'm (clay), 900 f'm (concrete masonry)
sources.ultimateStrain: TMS 402 / ACI 530-08 Sec 3.3.2(c): εmu 0.0035 clay, 0.0025 concrete masonry
sources.axial: TMS 402 / ACI 530-08 Eqs. 3-15, 3-16 (unreinforced) and 3-18, 3-19 (reinforced): Pn = 0.80 [0.80 An f'm] (1 - (h/140r)²) for h/r ≤ 99, (70 r/h)² above
sources.fmRange: TMS 402 / ACI 530-08 Sec 3.1.8.1.1: f'm of strength design, clay 1500-6000 psi, concrete 1500-4000 psi
sources.modulusOfRupture: TMS 402 / ACI 530-08 Table 3.1.8.2, normal to bed joints, Portland cement/lime or mortar cement mortar (solid units; hollow units ungrouted or partly grouted; fully grouted)
sources.plainShear: TMS 402 / ACI 530-08 Sec 3.2.4: Vn the least of 3.8 An √f'm, 300 An, 56 An + 0.45 Nu (running bond, not solidly grouted), 90 An + 0.45 Nu (running bond, solidly grouted), 23 An (stack bond) psi
sources.reinforcedShear: TMS 402 / ACI 530-08 Sec 3.3.4.1.2: Vnm = [4.0 - 1.75 (Mu/(Vu dv))] An √f'm + 0.25 Pu, Vns = 0.5 (Av/s) fy dv; Vn ≤ 6 An √f'm at Mu/(Vu dv) ≤ 0.25, 4 An √f'm at ≥ 1.0 (psi)
sources.maxSteelStrain: TMS 402 / ACI 530-08 Sec 3.3.3.5: the extreme tension steel strain at εmu is at least α εy, α 1.5 (ordinary), 3 (intermediate walls in-plane), 4 (special walls in-plane)
sources.ordinaryWalls: TMS 402 / ACI 530-08 Sec 1.17.3.2.3.1: ordinary reinforced masonry shear walls, bars of at least 0.2 in² (129 mm²) at most 120 in (3048 mm) apart
sources.mortarFromMix: SAEngine practice where the mortar type is not entered: a cement : sand mix of up to 1 : 3 is taken as type M, up to 1 : 4.5 as type S, leaner as type N (ASTM C270 proportions, approximately)
sources.prismStrength: TMS 602 / ACI 530.1-08 Tables 1 (clay) and 2 (concrete masonry): f'm on the net area from the unit's net-area strength by mortar type, in MPa (from memory, to be checked)
